title: Physical Exercise for Prevention of Dementia
brief_summary: The principal aim of this study is to verify whether a program of supervised, multimodal physical exercise improves cognitive function and/or reduces the rate of cognitive decline in older adults
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Age \> 50 years old

Exclusion Criteria:

* Medical conditions that compromise survival or limit physical activity
* Geriatric Depression Scale-15 score of 6 or higher
* Alcohol intake \> 4 units/day
* Mini- Mental State Examination \< 24
* Clinical Dementia Rating score of 1 or more
